title: T1000-E: LoRa radio (LR1110)
description: Validate LR1110 radio on T1000-E. Radio is modeled and enabled by overlays but driver/hardware validation pending. Test SPI bus, reset, DIO interrupts, and TX/RX.
notes:
BLOCKED: Requires physical hardware access. Driver code exists (lr1110.c, lr1110_hal.c), devicetree is modeled with correct pin assignments (verified against Meshtastic variant.h), but hardware validation requires:
1. Physical T1000-E board
2. Test equipment (logic analyzer/scope) for SPI bus validation
3. Manual testing of reset line (P1.10) and DIO interrupts (P0.07, P1.01)
4. RF test equipment or second node for TX/RX validation
Cannot be resolved by software changes alone.
close_reason: Blocked on hardware - software side complete (driver code lr1110.c/lr1110_hal.c, devicetree). Requires physical T1000-E board and test equipment for SPI/RF validation. Cannot proceed without hardware access.
